"Patriotic Payout" has eight of eight top prizes left and is still new. Only a small slice of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "Patriotic Payout" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2776.headline: Where this game is in its run

2779.body:
"Gnome for the Holidays" has 1,007,111 prizes of $1 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $100 prize, with 2,243 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "Gnome for the Holidays" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2779.headline: Prize table details

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" just went on sale in Texas. The game has ten full prize levels with five top prizes of $100,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Everything here about "Holiday Countdown" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through November 2.
2780.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" has joined the Texas lineup at $10 with five top prizes of $250,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

If you play "The Perfect Gift" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2781.headline: New game, all prizes left

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $20 game with four top prizes of $1 million. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

The table below shows the full count for "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe", with every prize level included.
